workup.label: Complete ALL diagnosis, molecular characterization, baseline MRD clone definition, CNS evaluation, workup and transplant evaluation before treatment routing.

recommendation.title: Complete ALL diagnosis, molecular characterization, baseline MRD clone definition, CNS evaluation, workup and transplant evaluation before treatment routing.

options.label: Molecular/cytogenetic characterization
options.text: Complete BCR::ABL1 and recurrent genomic testing required for subtype/risk-directed therapy.

options.label: Lumbar puncture with intrathecal therapy
options.text: Perform CNS evaluation/prophylaxis according to ALL-3/ALL-B.

surveillance.label: ALL surveillance after completion of therapy with clinical/CBC follow-up, disease-specific molecular monitoring, and prompt relapse workup when indicated.

recommendation.title: ALL surveillance after completion of therapy with clinical/CBC follow-up, disease-specific molecular monitoring, and prompt relapse workup when indicated.

lineage_missing.label: ALL lineage is unresolved or outside B-ALL/T-ALL scope.

need_ph.label: BCR::ABL1/Philadelphia status is required before B-ALL treatment routing.

bph_mrd.label: MRD negative at current post-treatment timepoint?

need_mrd_bph.label: Current MRD status is required for Ph-positive B-ALL post-remission routing.

bph_initial.label: Ph-positive B-ALL initial therapy: TKI-containing induction selected by age/comorbidity, with mandatory CNS prophylaxis and response/MRD assessment.

recommendation.title: Ph-positive B-ALL initial therapy: TKI-containing induction selected by age/comorbidity, with mandatory CNS prophylaxis and response/MRD assessment.

options.label: TKI + HyperCVAD
options.text: Other recommended for patients <65 without substantial comorbidities.

options.label: TKI + corticosteroid
options.text: Useful in certain circumstances; also low-intensity option in older/comorbid patients.

options.label: TKI + dose-adjusted EPOCH
options.text: Moderate-intensity option for age >=65 or substantial comorbidities.

options.label: TKI + mini-hyperCVD
options.text: Moderate-intensity option for age >=65 or substantial comorbidities.

options.label: TKI + PhALLCON regimen
options.text: Moderate-intensity option for age >=65 or substantial comorbidities.

options.label: CNS prophylaxis / intrathecal therapy
options.text: All ALL regimens include CNS prophylaxis.

bph_mrdpos.label: Ph-positive B-ALL in marrow CR with persistent MRD: MRD-directed consolidation/escalation.

recommendation.title: Ph-positive B-ALL in marrow CR with persistent MRD: MRD-directed consolidation/escalation.

options.label: Allogeneic HCT
options.text: Consider in appropriate candidates after response.

options.label: CNS-directed/prophylactic intrathecal therapy
options.text: Required per ALL regimen and CNS status.

bph_mrdneg.label: Ph-positive B-ALL in MRD-negative marrow CR: continue source-defined consolidation/maintenance with HCT for appropriate candidates.

recommendation.title: Ph-positive B-ALL in MRD-negative marrow CR: continue source-defined consolidation/maintenance with HCT for appropriate candidates.

need_mrd_bneg.label: Current MRD status is required for Ph-negative B-ALL post-remission routing.

bneg_initial.label: Ph-negative B-ALL initial induction selected by age/fitness with CNS prophylaxis and planned response/MRD assessment.

recommendation.title: Ph-negative B-ALL initial induction selected by age/fitness with CNS prophylaxis and planned response/MRD assessment.

options.label: CALGB 10403
options.text: Preferred for AYA without substantial comorbidities.

options.label: DFCI ALL regimen
options.text: Preferred for AYA without substantial comorbidities.

options.label: ECOG 1910
options.text: Other recommended for adults <65 without substantial comorbidities; also high-intensity option in older/comorbid patients.

options.label: HyperCVAD
options.text: Other recommended for <65 without substantial comorbidities.

bneg_mrdpos.label: Ph-negative B-ALL in marrow CR with MRD positivity: blinatumomab-based post-remission therapy with HCT consideration for high-risk/eligible patients.

recommendation.title: Ph-negative B-ALL in marrow CR with MRD positivity: blinatumomab-based post-remission therapy with HCT consideration for high-risk/eligible patients.

options.label: Blinatumomab
options.text: Alternative when multiagent therapy is contraindicated.

bneg_mrdneg.label: Ph-negative B-ALL in MRD-negative marrow CR: post-remission blinatumomab/continued multiagent therapy and maintenance or HCT according to risk/candidacy.

recommendation.title: Ph-negative B-ALL in MRD-negative marrow CR: post-remission blinatumomab/continued multiagent therapy and maintenance or HCT according to risk/candidacy.

need_mrd_t.label: Current MRD status is required for T-ALL post-remission routing.

t_initial.label: T-ALL initial induction selected by age/fitness with CNS prophylaxis.

recommendation.title: T-ALL initial induction selected by age/fitness with CNS prophylaxis.

options.label: CALGB 10403
options.text: Preferred for AYA without substantial comorbidities.

options.label: COG AALL0434
options.text: Preferred for AYA without substantial comorbidities.

options.label: HyperCVAD
options.text: Other recommended for <65 without substantial comorbidities.

options.label: Dose-adjusted GRAALL-2014
options.text: Other recommended for adults <65 without substantial comorbidities.

t_mrdpos.label: T-ALL in marrow CR with MRD positivity: continue multiagent therapy and consider allogeneic HCT, particularly with high-risk disease or slow/incomplete MRD clearance.

recommendation.title: T-ALL in marrow CR with MRD positivity: continue multiagent therapy and consider allogeneic HCT, particularly with high-risk disease or slow/incomplete MRD clearance.

options.label: Allogeneic HCT
options.text: Favored for high-risk T-ALL/slow MRD clearance.

t_mrdneg.label: T-ALL in MRD-negative marrow CR: continue multiagent therapy then maintenance or HCT when high-risk/appropriate.

recommendation.title: T-ALL in MRD-negative marrow CR: continue multiagent therapy then maintenance or HCT when high-risk/appropriate.

rr_phplus.label: Relapsed/refractory Ph-positive B-ALL: ABL1 mutation-directed TKI-based salvage with immunotherapy/cellular therapy and HCT consolidation when appropriate.

recommendation.title: Relapsed/refractory Ph-positive B-ALL: ABL1 mutation-directed TKI-based salvage with immunotherapy/cellular therapy and HCT consolidation when appropriate.

options.label: Mutation-appropriate TKI
options.text: Asciminib +/- another TKI, bosutinib, dasatinib, imatinib, nilotinib, or ponatinib per mutation/tolerance.

options.label: Tisagenlecleucel
options.text: Age <26, refractory or >=2 relapses, after therapy including two TKIs.

options.label: CNS-directed therapy/prophylaxis
options.text: Systemic therapy is required even for isolated extramedullary relapse.

options.label: Second allogeneic HCT and/or donor lymphocyte infusion
options.text: For relapse after prior allogeneic HCT, a second HCT and/or DLI can be considered when clinically appropriate.

rr_phnegative.label: Relapsed/refractory Ph-negative B-ALL: antigen/age/prior-treatment-directed immunotherapy or cellular therapy, other salvage regimens, and HCT consolidation when appropriate.

recommendation.title: Relapsed/refractory Ph-negative B-ALL: antigen/age/prior-treatment-directed immunotherapy or cellular therapy, other salvage regimens, and HCT consolidation when appropriate.

options.label: Tisagenlecleucel
options.text: Preferred for age <26 with refractory disease or >=2 relapses.

options.label: Second allogeneic HCT and/or donor lymphocyte infusion
options.text: For relapse after prior allogeneic HCT, a second HCT and/or DLI can be considered when clinically appropriate.

rr_tall.label: Relapsed/refractory T-ALL: clinical trial preferred; source-listed salvage regimens with molecularly directed therapy when applicable, CNS management, and HCT consolidation when appropriate.

recommendation.title: Relapsed/refractory T-ALL: clinical trial preferred; source-listed salvage regimens with molecularly directed therapy when applicable, CNS management, and HCT consolidation when appropriate.

options.label: Second allogeneic HCT and/or donor lymphocyte infusion
options.text: For relapse after prior allogeneic HCT, a second HCT and/or DLI can be considered when clinically appropriate.

outside.label: Case is outside the acute lymphoblastic leukemia ruleset.

consistency_rules.message: Ph-positive ALL branch is B-lineage-specific in this package.
Active relapse/refractory disease cannot remain on routine surveillance.
